title: Swing a hammer at 10% of light speed and it hits like 4 Hiroshimas

beats.say: Swing a hammer at 10% of the speed of light, and it hits with the energy of more than 4 Hiroshima bombs.
beats.speak: Swing a hammer at ten percent of the speed of light, and it hits with the energy of more than four Hiroshima bombs.

head: FIRST,
A REAL SWING.
beats.say: First, a real swing. Researchers tracked carpenters hammering: the head moved at 2.01 metres per second. A 0.57 kilogram head. That's 1.15 joules. The nail sinks.
beats.speak: First, a real swing. Researchers tracked carpenters hammering: the head moved at two point zero one metres per second. A zero point five seven kilogram head. That's one point one five joules. The nail sinks.

head: NOW YOU AND THE
HAMMER CAN'T BREAK.
beats.say: Now make you and the hammer unbreakable, and swing as fast as sound: 340 metres per second. That's 28,646 times the energy.
beats.speak: Now make you and the hammer unbreakable, and swing as fast as sound: three hundred and forty metres per second. That's twenty eight thousand six hundred and forty six times the energy.

head: FASTER:
SPACE STATION SPEED.
beats.say: Faster. Swing it at the speed of the space station: 7,823 metres per second. 17.4 million joules. About 4 kilograms of TNT.
beats.speak: Faster. Swing it at the speed of the space station: seven thousand eight hundred and twenty three metres per second. Seventeen point four million joules. About four kilograms of T N T.

head: NOW 10% OF
LIGHT SPEED.
beats.say: Now 10% of light speed. 61,683 tons of TNT. Hiroshima was 15,000 tons. More than 4 Hiroshimas, from one swing.
beats.speak: Now ten percent of light speed. Sixty one thousand six hundred and eighty three tons of T N T. Hiroshima was fifteen thousand tons. More than four Hiroshimas, from one swing.

head: YOU'RE FINE.
NOTHING ELSE IS.
beats.say: Remember, only you and the hammer are unbreakable. Nothing else in this town is.

head: NOW 99% OF
LIGHT SPEED.
beats.say: Push it to 99% of light speed: 74.6 million tons of TNT. 4,970 Hiroshimas.
beats.speak: Push it to ninety nine percent of light speed: seventy four point six million tons of T N T. Four thousand nine hundred and seventy Hiroshimas.

head: AND AT LIGHT
SPEED ITSELF?
beats.say: And at the speed of light itself? You can't. Physics says it would take an infinite amount of energy. The hammer never lands.
Follow Ship With Pip for more.

caption: A real hammer swing: the head moves at about 2.01 m/s (measured on carpenters), and a 0.57 kg head carries 1.15 joules. Make you and the hammer unbreakable and speed it up. As fast as sound: 32,984 J, 28,646 times more. Space station speed: 17.4 million J, about 4 kg of TNT. 10% of light speed: 61,683 tons of TNT, more than 4 Hiroshimas. 99%: 74.6 million tons, 4,970 Hiroshimas. At light speed itself the energy needed is infinite, so the hammer never lands. Kinetic energy, with relativity for the fast ones.
notes: m_head_kg 0.57 and v_swing_ms 2.01: Buchanan et al 2016 (UW Madison ergonomics), 'All hammers had 0.57 kg heads'; 'The mean initial velocity was 2.01 m/s' (WH hammer, head tracked through impact with the nail).
sound_mph 761: NASA Glenn, speed of sound at sea level on a standard day 'about 761 mph'.
iss_mph 17500: NASA Spot the Station FAQ, 'about 17,500 mph'.
mph_ms 0.44704: exact definition (1 mile = 1609.344 m, per hour / 3600).
ton_tnt_J 4.184e9: TNT equivalent convention (4.184 GJ), attributed to NIST SP 811; kg of TNT = ton / 1000 (metric ton).
hiroshima_tons 15000: Britannica, 'the equivalent of 15,000 tons of TNT'.
Infinite energy at light speed: DOE Explains Relativity, 'an infinite amount of energy is required to make an object move at the speed of light'.

Constants 10 and 99 are the chosen premise speeds (percent of c). Relativistic KE (gamma-1)mc^2 used from ISS speed up (identical to classical there to 4 sig figs). Hook '4 Hiroshimas' = ke10_hiroshimas 4.11 rounded, spoken as 'more than four'.
